estimate.assumptions: Conservative bound using every turn and harness request allowance, maximum input size and response limit; runs may end earlier. Token caps do not guarantee a dollar cost for unpriced models. No provider request was sent.

completion.interpretation: Complete means the rules ended this trajectory; it does not establish success or competence.

limitations: The shared-information control changes evidence read ACLs only; no cooperation is required.
Directory roles, turn/conflict priority, directed routes and their order are explicit assumptions.
Phased observations freeze until settlement; physical model requests may be serial.
Logical mail delivery and input receipts establish availability/inclusion, not attention or intent.
Scripted demonstration of the viewer and rules; not evidence of model behavior.

observation.rules: Choose any declared alternative, wait, inspect permitted artifacts, or stop to abstain personally. Each final choice earns your immutable value for that option, plus 3 only if all three choose the same option. Unchosen/abstaining actors earn zero. Role labels confer no permissions. Sequential decisions settle immediately, one logical tick per action. Phased decisions use a frozen observation until all active actors propose, then settle in declared conflict_order with one tick per barrier. Provider requests may be sampled serially; provider latency never advances logical time or sets priority. Choices are final and published only at settlement. Stop affects only you. The round horizon ends remaining work without forcing choices. Messages use only declared directed routes; route list order controls equal-time delivery ordering. Each addressed message arrives after delivery_delay logical ticks, after settlement, never while a phase is collecting proposals. Inbox and outbox are persistent current mailbox state in every memory mode. Queued is not delivered; terminal runs do not advance time to flush future messages.
